label: Learn a world by observation
description: Seven real workflow-engine stages matching the ARC3 apprenticeship workbench: bind a world, capture state, preserve an objectification boundary, observe a human action, capture the result, explain the transition, and decide whether to continue.

steps.label: Select world
steps.description: Bind the ARC3 scenario or environment adapter supplied to this run.

steps.label: Capture initial state
steps.description: Preserve the initial observation as a versioned workflow artifact.

steps.label: Objectify observation
steps.description: Keep an explicit processing boundary where shared or ARC3-specific objectification tasks can be substituted without changing the top-level workflow.

steps.label: Observe action
steps.description: Pause on a genuine engine human-input step while the demonstrator supplies the observed action.

steps.label: Capture result
steps.description: Preserve the observation resulting from the action.

steps.label: Explain transition
steps.description: Build a persisted before/after transition record that later symbolic or LLM explanation tasks can refine.

steps.label: Repeat or conclude
steps.description: Pause for an explicit continuation decision instead of pretending the control loop is automatic.
